howto.name: View the metadata
howto.text: PrivaTools displays the document's Title, Author, Subject, Keywords, Producer, Creator, Creation Date, Modified Date, and any custom XMP fields.

howto.name: Decide what to do next
howto.text: If you want to strip the metadata, use Strip Metadata. To set new values, use Update Metadata.

faq.q: What metadata does a typical PDF carry?
faq.a: At minimum: producer (the software that created it) and creation date. Often also: author name, original filename, software version. Scanned PDFs may carry scanner model + driver.

faq.q: Why does this matter for privacy?
faq.a: Producer + Creator + Author fields can identify the person or machine that created a document — useful in forensics, problematic for whistleblowers.
